snippet.title: Fluendora gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes is a relaxing multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle adventure where strategy meets tranquility. In this cozy experience, players engage in a unique word-building challenge, either competing for the highest score or enjoying a peaceful solo session in a beautifully crafted low-poly environment.

Legends say the land took its name from the sacred river Fluent, whose waters flow with such clarity that words come to life within them.

Today, we know this realm as Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes, a sanctuary where language is not just spoken, but where under the glow of the moonlight, scribes gather to weave every word from the heart of the stream.

The river is waiting, will you join the flow?

music by https://www.freepik.com/audio/artist/mudig
